lines.text: She saved R1,250. Then paid more than full price.
A R6,250 TV, on Black Friday for R5,000.
On a store card over 12 months, at the legal maximums.
Interest, the R69 monthly fee and credit life add about R1,570.
That's about R320 more than the full price.
A discount on credit isn't always a discount. Save R500 a month for 10 months, and pay cash.
Full store card guide on the channel.
So... did she really save R1,250?
